subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To burn the midnight oil

options.text: To work late into the night
To be energetic during the day

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. "To work late into the night".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To burn the midnight oil"** means to work late into the night, especially in order to complete a task or achieve something. (रात देर तक काम करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The students burned the midnight oil to prepare for their final exams.
 
 
 
• In this context, it refers to putting in extra effort and working beyond normal hours to complete a task or assignment.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To sleep early** (जल्दी सोना): Refers to going to bed early, typically to maintain a healthy routine.

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to sleep early to wake up fresh for the meeting tomorrow.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: To waste time** (समय बर्बाद करना): Refers to spending time unproductively or in a way that does not yield meaningful results.
 
 
• **Example:** Stop wasting time on social media and focus on your studies.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To be energetic during the day** (दिन के समय ऊर्जावान होना): Refers to being active and full of energy during the daytime.
 
 
• **Example:** She is always energetic during the day and completes all her tasks efficiently.
 
 

41:T909,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
